name: settings-view-seat
description: The page opens the dialog modal of the settings element, which spans the whole window, and the modal document reports the seat core.settings-modal.plugin-view and the pane core.settings-modal.pane of a plugin page, then the seat scrolled out of the pane, then the seat back inside it; the page measures the seat of the settings surface from each report and closes the modal by its element id, which the host answers with null.
reason: overlayShow opens a native modal view in the window, and the modal document sends its state through the overlay-pick notice; only the native host with a window produces them (the native tier of docs/operations/examples.md#test-kinds).
